fairUse.provenance: Official product page: https://gamewright.com/product/sushi-go. Exact downloadable high-resolution image file: https://gamewright.com/images/twenty/GAMEWRIGHT-249.jpg. Edition check: publisher product page title and box match Sushi Go! and the cited Gamewright rules.

firstPlayerRule: Everyone chooses a card secretly at the same time. Once everyone has chosen, reveal the cards together; no single player starts.
officialTieBreak: Not applicable: selection and reveal are simultaneous.
clarifications: After revealing, pass the remaining hand to the player on your left.
This entry covers Sushi Go!, not Sushi Go Party! or Sushi Roll.
